result.rationale: The migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts values verbatim via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing the model's `before_validation` scheme/path stripping. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host) = ?` against `uri.host` only, and the removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` explicitly accepted values like 'http://discourse.org' and 'https://example.com/1234' (as the spec change shows). Migrated entries containing a scheme or path will never match, silently breaking embedding after upgrade. This is a verifiable data-migration
